mapper.update: update yc_activity set cover_url = replace(cover_url, #{oldPrefix}, #{newPrefix}) where cover_url like concat(#{oldPrefix}, '%')

update yc_activity_config
mobile_background_url = replace(mobile_background_url, #{oldPrefix}, #{newPrefix}), audio_url = replace(audio_url, #{oldPrefix}, #{newPrefix}), footer_logo_url = replace(footer_logo_url, #{oldPrefix}, #{newPrefix}), mobile_blocks_json = replace(mobile_blocks_json, #{oldPrefix}, #{newPrefix})
where mobile_background_url like concat(#{oldPrefix}, '%') or audio_url like concat(#{oldPrefix}, '%') or footer_logo_url like concat(#{oldPrefix}, '%') or mobile_blocks_json like concat('%', #{oldPrefix}, '%')
